#+TITLE: Test Suite for Org to Markdown Preview Conversion

* 1. Common Constructs

#+NAME: Headline with all elements
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
,* TODO [#A] Complete headline *inline bold* [2/5] :work:project:
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
# <span class="org-todo">TODO</span> <span class="org-priority">[#A]</span> Complete headline <strong>inline bold</strong> <span class="org-progress">[2/5]</span> <span class="org-tags">:work:project:</span>

#+NAME: Paragraph with links timestamps and math
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
Text with [[https://example.com][link]] and <2024-01-01 Mon> plus $x^2$ and *bold*.
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
Text with [link](https://example.com) and <span class="org-timestamp"><2024-01-01 Mon></span> plus $x^2$ and <strong>bold</strong>.

#+NAME: Image links render with Markdown image syntax
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
See [[./assets/orgdown.png][OrgDown logo]] and [[https://example.com/logo.svg][web logo]].
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
See ![OrgDown logo](./assets/orgdown.png) and ![web logo](https://example.com/logo.svg).

#+NAME: Source block with language
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
#+BEGIN_SRC python
print("hello")
#+END_SRC
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
```python
print("hello")
```

#+NAME: Quote block with comment and drawer
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
#+BEGIN_QUOTE
Quote text
#+END_QUOTE
:LOGBOOK:
skip me
:END:
# comment line
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
> Quote text

#+NAME: Table conversion
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
| a | b |
|----+----|
| 1 | 2 |
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
| a | b |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 |

#+NAME: List with checkbox and nested items
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
- item one
- [X] item two
  - nested a
  - nested b
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
- item one
- [x] item two
  - nested a
  - nested b

#+NAME: Headline levels with section content
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
,* Level 1
Text under level 1.
,** Level 2
More text.
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
# Level 1
Text under level 1.

## Level 2
More text.

#+NAME: Footnote reference and definition
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
Text[fn:1] with footnote.

[fn:1] The footnote body.
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
Text[^1] with footnote.


[^1]: The footnote body.

#+NAME: Horizontal rule
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
-----
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
---

#+NAME: Title directive and planning line
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
#+TITLE: My Document
SCHEDULED: <2025-01-01 Wed>
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
# My Document

<p class="org-planning"><span class="org-plan-keyword">SCHEDULED:</span> <span class="org-timestamp"><2025-01-01 Wed></span></p>

#+NAME: Dynamic block
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
#+BEGIN: clocktable :scope file
| 1 |
#+END:
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
```clocktable
| 1 |
```
